title: callista pandurata
intro: Callista pandurata, commonly known as the Pigeon Wings or the Butterfly Tree, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, thanks to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Callista pandurata include its analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids. Research on the plant's bioactive constituents has shown that it also contains alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
